summary: Owned Office validation is slide-scoped by QID and requires exact source/reopen readback, render hashes, source SHA, PID/HWND ownership, and zero survivors.
invariants: QID uniqueness is enforced per slide; the same canonical QID may appear on different slides.
Source and reopened slide+QID ownership must exactly match the product manifest.
PowerPoint QA accepts a nonnegative inspection_failures count but never self-promotes visual parity.
Source PPTX SHA must remain unchanged and all launched Office processes must be gone after validation.
forbidden: Do not attach to, save, close, or terminate an ownership-uncertain Office process.
Do not equate exact reopen render hashes with semantic editability or cross-renderer visual parity.
